stem:
Read this sentence from the story.

He is a sweet man with a honey tongue and he is a teller of tales.

Why does the author include this description of Bompie?

options.label: A
options.text: To show that Sophie knows only what she has been told about her grandfather

options.label: B
options.text: To explain why Sophie's grandfather decided to move away

options.label: C
options.text: To convey why Sophie is eager to see her grandfather

options.label: D
options.text: To explain that Sophie does not trust what her grandfather says
